SPEC.title: HDD instrument specification v0.7
SPEC.confidence: approved_circuit_requirements; older PCB process superseded by BRIEF

NET.title: Approved logical parts and netlist
NET.confidence: approved_logical_connectivity; physical fit remains T5 scope

TI_DRV.title: TI DRV8874 datasheet, SLVSF66A, Rev. A
TI_DRV.fact: Local bypass and bulk capacitors should be close; power conductors wide; IC grounds joined on the carrier. Bulk sizing needs system testing.

TI_LAYOUT.title: TI Best Practices for Board Layout of Motor Drivers, SLVA959B
TI_LAYOUT.fact: Shared impedance and nearby switching wires can disturb signals. Separate current paths and small high-current loops are useful.

POLOLU.title: Pololu #4035 DRV8874 carrier
POLOLU.location: Using the motor driver; Pinout; Current limiting; Real-world power dissipation considerations
POLOLU.fact: VIN is the recommended protected input; VM is downstream access. PWM adds heat; handling can burn. Carrier already contains the IC support components.

POLOLU_WIRE.title: Pololu application note: Dealing with Motor Noise
POLOLU_WIRE.confidence: verified_primary; wiring principle transferred from brushed motors to switched VCM wiring
POLOLU_WIRE.fact: Short paired/twisted motor leads, separation from signal wires, and local supply capacitance reduce interference. No capacitor across the VCM is proposed here.

MINMAX.title: MINMAX M78AR-1 datasheet, 2016-11-22 Rev.0
MINMAX.location: model table p.1; input notes and pin connections p.3; Technical Notes p.4
MINMAX.fact: M78AR05-1: input 6.5–32 V, output 5 V/1 A, maximum output capacitance 470 uF. Input capacitor goes across input pins; ripple note places a low-ESR capacitor near the load. No numeric lead-distance limit is given.

PICO_PIN.title: Raspberry Pi Pico 1/Pico 2 official pinout
PICO_PIN.access: opened_primary; diagram cross-checked with indexed rendering and approved NET

PICO_DS.title: Raspberry Pi Pico datasheet
PICO_DS.location: 2.1/2.2 pin descriptions pp.7–8; 4.5 Powering Pico p.20
PICO_DS.access: primary_search_excerpts_read; full PDF open failed (>10 MiB); direct download unavailable
PICO_DS.fact: VSYS 1.8–5.5 V; external power via Schottky to VSYS allows USB power ORing. AGND is ADC reference ground; digital-ground connection is allowed when ADC performance is not critical. Recommended external 3V3 load below 300 mA.

BOURNS.title: Bourns MF-R PPTC datasheet, Rev.AG
BOURNS.location: electrical table p.1; thermal derating p.3; trip curves p.4
BOURNS.fact: MF-R300: 3 A hold at 23 C, 2.49 A at 40 C; initial resistance 0.020–0.050 ohm, post-trip R1 maximum 0.080 ohm. Trip is not instantaneous.

DIODE.title: Panjit 1N5820–1N5822 datasheet, 2009-03-25
DIODE.location: ratings/electrical characteristics p.1; derating and forward curves p.2
DIODE.fact: 1N5822: 3 A average under specified lead-temperature conditions; VF maximum 0.525 V at 3 A. Small perfboard solder pads do not reproduce the rating test conditions.

TVS.title: Panjit P4KE series datasheet, 2022-08-25 Rev.06
TVS.location: p.1 selection note; P4KE15A row p.2
TVS.fact: P4KE15A: stand-off 12.8 V; breakdown 14.3–15.8 V; clamp 21.2 V at specified 20 A pulse. Wiring inductance can add overshoot.

ALPHA.title: Alpha Wire Premium 3051
ALPHA.fact: 22 AWG tinned copper; nominal DCR 16.2 ohm/1000 ft at 20 C, equivalent to 0.05315 ohm/m. This is not an ampacity claim.

ALPHA_SIZE.title: Alpha Wire Hook-Up Wire Brochure, 2023
ALPHA_SIZE.fact: Examples: 20 AWG about 0.51 mm2; solid 22 AWG 0.64 mm diameter / 0.32 mm2; solid 24 AWG 0.51 mm / 0.20 mm2. Stranded constructions differ.

ADAFRUIT.title: Adafruit Pocket PiGRRL — Perma-Proto
ADAFRUIT.location: Using Half-size Perma-Proto; planning and marking
ADAFRUIT.fact: Plan and mark a prototype board and its power rails. Perma-Proto has internally connected pads; the actual T5 board must have its own pad connectivity model.

ENG.title: T7 engineering proposals and calculations, 2026-10-22
ENG.location: Numeric-target policy, current budget, floor plans, and rule catalogue
ENG.fact: All new clearances, wire areas, length limits, voltage-drop budgets, jumper counts, and floor-plan positions are proposed design targets requiring Claude review and physical verification.

rules.rationale: A short/open, using carrier VM instead of VIN, or a bypassed isolation diode defeats the approved circuit.
Every physical contact is an electrical junction; crossing layers at a plated pad can still short.
A 0.5 mm physical margin allows for bent wire and solder spread at low voltage; it is a workmanship target.
Allow at least 1.016 mm between unrelated bodies/sockets; no stacking or hidden fouling.
Four M3 mounts need screw/washer/tool room and a copper-free margin; radii include holes, pads and bare wire.
Reserve 20.32 mm outward cable/plug approach with at least 12 mm corridor width; actual plug may require more.
BOOTSEL must be pressable with modules inserted; a 10.16 mm diameter free top approach is proposed.
Socketed modules must lift out without bending nearby wires; reserve two opposite grip sides, with power removed.
Plugs, latch fingers and panel harnesses need a clear exit; include the actual T5 connector mating envelope.
Edge access keeps cable loads and connector manipulation outside the component field.
Edge access keeps cable loads and connector manipulation outside the component field.
Keep the USB mouth within 5.08 mm of an edge while satisfying the full cable corridor.
USB must face the edge to which its unobstructed corridor exits.
Repeat identical socket/pin order on all four channels to reduce assembly mistakes; no mirrored carriers.
A probe must reach each labelled point without removing modules or contacting adjacent voltage nodes.
Keep each CS probe local; the omitted ADC scaffold does not justify long floating analogue stubs.
At least 7.62 mm body-edge gap supports convection and module handling; verify temperature in the enclosure.
Prefer 10.16 mm gaps where board area permits.
Separate the roughly 1–1.4 W series diode from PPTC and electrolytic bodies by at least 10.16 mm.
Do not warm the temperature-sensitive PPTC with the switching regulator.
Keep the PPTC outside the motor-driver heat zone.
Leave at least 2.54 mm air gap; put local capacitors beside the VIN corner, not above a hot carrier.
Maintain a 2.54 mm body gap while keeping regulator capacitor leads short.
Keep the switched protection/bulk cluster physically at the supply entry; TVS remains on VM, after the panel switch.
Each TVS attachment is at most 7.62 mm of external conductor; long leads weaken the clamp through inductance.
Limit entry positive/return attachment to 15.24 mm each; no long spur from a distant trunk to the entry capacitor.
Keep the entry circuitry in one 60.96 mm block without violating diode/PTC heat clearance.
100 nF terminals within 5.08 mm Manhattan distance of carrier VIN and adjacent power GND.
Limit each external 100 nF lead/wire path to 5.08 mm; the carrier already handles IC charge-pump bypassing.
Prefer directly adjacent holes (2.54 mm each external connection).
Keep both local 470 uF connections within 15.24 mm of VIN/GND; body clearance is evaluated separately.
Each bulk-capacitor connection is at most 15.24 mm and goes directly to its channel supply node.
Prefer 7.62 mm bulk connections when the can and grip clearances allow.
Each coil connector terminal is within 10.16 mm of its corresponding OUT pin.
Keep board-side OUT leads at most 10.16 mm each; output wiring stays at the perimeter.
Put the specified 100 uF input/output capacitors within 10.16 mm pin distance of the converter.
Each converter capacitor attachment is at most 10.16 mm; this numeric limit is a perfboard proposal.
Receiver bypass should be at its supply pins, including any SOT-23 adapter routing.
Allow at most 7.62 mm including the SMD conversion board; use an adapter-local capacitor if necessary.
Motor returns get their own heavy distribution branch; no driver return segment may lie in the converter/Pico/divider supply-return branch.
Use a local low-current hub; connect AGND33 to this quiet Pico ground network, never use it as a motor-current return.
Four individual branches start at the divider/filter junction; a daisy chain makes later channels depend on earlier wiring joints.
The 220 nF filter and both divider junctions form one compact source; no ground detour through a channel.
Limit each divider/filter junction attachment to 5.08 mm.
A 101.6 mm absolute branch ceiling fits a central divider and avoids long high-impedance loops; it is not an EMI guarantee.
Prefer branches <=63.5 mm; put the divider centrally behind the driver row.
Keep sensitive/stop/receiver wires at least 5.08 mm from switched outputs and coil connector bodies; only the FAULT pin escape is exempt.
Give the common current-limit reference at least 7.62 mm output separation with no long parallel run.
Prefer 10.16 mm between control wiring and OUT zones.
Cap each Pico GP2–GP9 PWM path at 152.4 mm on the chosen standard-size board; no external PWM harness.
Prefer PWM paths <=88.9 mm; match channel order to the physical Pico pin order.
Bound on-board SLEEP/FAULT paths to 203.2 mm. No equal-length requirement; avoid perimeter detours.
Put the external stop pull-down on the board at the bus origin; put FAULT pull-up near the Pico receiver.
The stop pull-down must remain on the driver side of an unplugged panel harness.
Keep pass-through connectors together, before the receiver series resistor.
The series resistor and powered-off-tolerant receiver belong at the UART entry, not at the far end of a long bus stub.
Each UART receiver input attachment <=15.24 mm, including conversion-board conductors.
Keep buffered UART RX on-board and <=101.6 mm; route through the quiet corridor.
A <=30.48 mm receiver cluster remains easy to inspect and prevents a long unprotected stub.

manual_checks.check: Use the user-requested single-sided independent-pad board with bare wiring on the bottom. Do not reserve an area for omitted temperature/current/voltage scaffold. Use the real board pad connectivity and inspect jumpers at crossings.
manual_checks.rationale: The 2026-10-22 user answers added to BRIEF specify the construction method and no scaffold reservation.

manual_checks.check: Retain two sockets per Pico/carrier, components upward. Remove Pololu R2 and R4, retain R3; verify each module separately before insertion. Host-board carrier VM1 and IMODE10 remain NC.
manual_checks.rationale: An unmodified carrier can lift the common reference and defeat the intended current limit.

manual_checks.check: Actual J101, J104 contacts, panel power switch and harness must be rated >=3 A continuous at the intended ambient, with measured startup suitability. No solderless breadboard or unrated Dupont jumper in the common power path.
manual_checks.rationale: Wire size cannot compensate for an underspecified connector or contact.

manual_checks.check: Use 35 V bulk/input electrolytics with polarity marked; do not add extra capacitors or change the approved nets. Total connected U107 output capacitance must remain <=470 uF, including downstream capacitance effective during startup.
manual_checks.rationale: Respect capacitor surge margin and converter startup capacitance limit.

manual_checks.check: Respect T5 adapter/pin mappings and actual pad connectivity. Verify lead fit, solder area and strain relief; never force a 1.2–1.3 mm diode lead into a nominal 1 mm hole. Preserve NC holes on installed sockets.
manual_checks.rationale: Physical substitutions must not silently change electrical connectivity.

manual_checks.check: Label HDD1–4, OUT1/OUT2, VIN/GND, switch header net names, USB access, probe nets and module insertion orientation. Secure external cables independently of component leads; provide a clear gap above capacitor vents.
manual_checks.rationale: Hand-built transportable hardware needs inspectable orientation and mechanical support.

manual_checks.check: Keep GP17, GP18, GP26–GP28 unconnected on the host board after scaffold removal. Keep U201.35 ADC_VREF and U201.40 VBUS NC; U201.33 AGND joins the local quiet GND network.
manual_checks.rationale: Leave the specified expansion pins free and preserve the approved power-ORing arrangement.

manual_checks.check: No bare live conductors, tall parts or extra wires above Pico/carriers; exclude only their required socket contacts. No component stacked over the diode or the converter. Insulate any intentional wire crossover fully and provide strain relief.
manual_checks.rationale: Heat escape, module removal and short inspection require accessible, unstacked construction.

manual_checks.check: Perform unpowered continuity/short checks, then regulator-only, Pico-only and one-carrier-at-a-time bring-up. Check +5V first; +3V3 is measurable only after Pico is inserted or USB-powered.
manual_checks.rationale: Avoid the literal v0.7 8.2 wording that asks to check 3V3 with Pico absent; 3V3 is generated on Pico.

manual_checks.check: At initial 4.7k divider setting, verify VREF approximately 0.30 V, unchanged by SLEEP, and approximately 0.27 A current limit in both directions on each carrier. Scope driver-local GND relative to VREF_GND and reference ripple. Proposed targets: |ground offset| <=10 mV and VREF ripple <=10 mV peak-to-peak; if exceeded, improve routing or obtain explicit review.
manual_checks.rationale: Low reference voltage makes millivolt-scale noise material. Geometric rules alone do not validate immunity.

manual_checks.check: Scope VM at the entry and furthest carrier and 3V3 during cold/hot repeated switching, four-channel playback and USB/adapter order tests. Measure charging current; verify no adapter hiccup or unwanted start and Pico VSYS always within 1.8–5.5 V.
manual_checks.rationale: The 2.35 mF bulk total has no bounded 2.6 A startup peak; TVS standoff and wiring inductance need a real supply test.

manual_checks.check: Log worst continuous current and enclosure air temperature at F102; at 40 C, 2.6 A exceeds MF-R300 2.49 A hold specification. Validate or derate operation; spacing is not a guarantee. Measure D103, PPTC, converter, carrier and coil temperatures until stable, at cold/hot startup and after transport.
manual_checks.rationale: The future 2.6 A operating allocation conflicts with the PPTC hold rating at 40 C; heat cannot be accepted from placement alone.

manual_checks.check: With the real panel harness, confirm stop opening, re-closing without restart, watchdog, bad/lost UART and FAULT stop outputs in <=0.5 s. Observe IN/CS with a scope; retain GP16 as SLEEP sense.
manual_checks.rationale: The physical SLEEP bus and receiver must support the specified fail-safe tests, including noise near OUT wiring.

manual_checks.check: At the worst approved load, measure common positive wire/contact drop <=0.13 V, common ground <=0.03 V and each selected driver feed/return <=0.02 V, so total J101-to-carrier supply loop wiring/contact loss <=0.20 V excluding F102/D103. Verify additional 5V and 3V3 branch budgets and cable-loop drop <=0.10 V.
manual_checks.rationale: Check actual joints and contacts, which ideal copper calculations omit.

assumptions: Proposed limits are project constraints subject to Claude review, not approved changes to the specification.

The updated BRIEF records the user preference: single-sided 2.54 mm isolated-pad board, mainly bottom-side tinned copper along the grid; insulated wires where crossings require them. Board outline, hole count, component envelopes and adapters come from T5. No standard board is declared to fit yet.
Do not impose the obsolete 100 x 100 mm PCB quote limit. Start with the prior approximately 155 x 115 mm class, then optimise occupied area only after hard constraints pass.

Only populated main-board parts and the practical probe set are required. The user explicitly requested no scaffold parts and no reserved scaffold area. TP464/TP465 may be retained as additional GND points; all other omissions are listed explicitly.
Use the 4.7k lower divider resistor initially. Wire sizing reserves the later 10k / approximately 0.6 A-per-coil envelope, subject to temperature tests.
Normal coil RMS 0.05–0.2 A is a trial range, not an approved sustained rating for any HDD; adapter current is neither coil RMS nor the sum of channel RMS.
Peak charging and fault currents are unknown. Wire size is selected for low voltage drop and robust assembly, not certification to an installation wiring ampacity code.
No extra capacitors on OUT, no IN-series resistors, no alternate buffer or connector electrical change, and no extra ground isolation is authorised by these rules.
Signals may need insulated jumpers to satisfy the mandatory spacing and exact connectivity; jumper counts are soft targets.

open_questions.topic: PPTC derating versus future continuous current
open_questions.context: Spec 6.6 allocates about 2.6 A maximum after the 10k upgrade, while MF-R300 holds only 2.49 A at 40 C. Moving it away from heat does not guarantee ambient below 40 C.
options: retain MF-R300 and explicitly require load/ambient derating and hot-enclosure validation before approving 10k operation
open_questions.recommendation: Retain the approved circuit and 4.7k start. Require measured current/ambient derating before any upgrade; do not substitute a larger PTC as a layout decision.
